description: Proposed routing policy; endpoint adapters and credentials are configured by the operator outside this public example.
digest_encoding: SHA-256 of JCS (RFC 8785) canonical UTF-8 JSON, not merely sorted-key compact JSON.

primary_visual.enable_requires: Operator enables only after the exact endpoint/adapter/model probes below pass.
primary_visual.unprobed_or_expired_capability: Unavailable; documentation alone does not activate this route.

backup_visual.enable_requires: Operator chooses a model/channel and passes the same role-required capability probes.

scene_tagger.when_video_unavailable: Timestamped images may support scene-content judgments within the shared byte budget, but are not equivalent to continuous video: subject-motion continuity stays unknown and continuity-dependent choices require NEEDS_REVIEW.
scene_tagger.output_contract: Evidence-scoped scene, subject continuity and photo composition judgments, including explicit unknowns.

sequence_editor.output_contract: Shot intents and approved candidate IDs; exact source windows, rules and rendering remain client-owned.

dispatch.eligibility: Enabled model AND fresh probe receipt AND every role-required capability AND remaining shared budget.
dispatch.candidate_limits: Enforce probed media count/size/context limits before dispatch; split evidence explicitly without silently dropping items.
dispatch.tool_policy: Intersect the runbook allowlist, active stage tools, job scope and client capability manifest; invalid configuration fails closed.
dispatch.context: Compile pinned runbook instructions and stage contract with canonical durable evidence; record the complete request digest.

context_repair.method: Replace bulky completed results with verified summaries and artifact references; retain user constraints, evidence coverage and pending hard gates.
forbidden: inventing a summary for unseen media
altering a failed gate to success

dispatch.paid_attempt_reservation: Atomically reserve token, USD, bytes and turn allowance before every attempt; primary and backup share the same ledger.

failure_policy.backoff: Bounded jittered backoff, honoring Retry-After only if remaining active AI time and job wall lifetime permit.
failure_policy.request_timeout: Connect, stream-idle and total-response limits are each clamped to remaining active AI seconds and job wall lifetime; local action timeouts and client CPU limits are separate.
failure_policy.http_timeout_semantics: Transport timeout does not prove inference stopped or billing was zero; record acceptance and cancellation as unknown unless confirmed.
failure_policy.unknown_charge: Keep the attempt reservation pending reconciliation; retry or switch only if another reservation fits, otherwise NEEDS_REVIEW.
failure_policy.idempotency: Use a stable request ID for tracing; claim provider-side deduplication only when the adapter has verified that guarantee.
failure_policy.backup_context: Resume the current stage from durable validated evidence and pending requirements; do not rerun completed client operations.
failure_policy.capability_downgrade: Forbidden: no visual-to-text fallback and no implicit tool-list expansion.
failure_policy.all_eligible_routes_failed: Request client rules_draft; valid drafts are NEEDS_REVIEW, otherwise INSUFFICIENT_MATERIAL. Retain evidence and reasons; do not automatically render.

observability.privacy: Store hashes, opaque IDs and redacted summaries by default; no credentials, absolute local paths, raw GPS or full-resolution media in model logs.
